children: Hagerty reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $354.2 million, down 9.5% from a year earlier, while net income attributable to Class A common stockholders fell to $8.4 million from $18.9 million. Diluted EPS was $0.08, compared with $0.11 in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue was $354.2M, compared with $391.4M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (9.5%).
Net income attributable to Class A common stockholders was $8.4M, compared with $18.9M; YoY change (55.7%).
Diluted EPS was $0.08, compared with $0.11; YoY change (27.3%).
Policies in force rose 18.1% to 1.91 million, while vehicles insured increased 13.4% to 3.11 million.
Beginning in January 2026, Hagerty Re assumed 100% of the risk on Essentia policies under the Markel arrangement, alongside expanded underwriting and claims control.
Net auction sales grew 83.2% over the first nine months, supported by signature auctions. Finance revenue also benefited from growth in the loan portfolio.
Hagerty Drivers Club paid membership increased 6.2% to 977,456, supported by growth in policies bundled with memberships.
Hagerty acquired U.K. motorcycle broker Bennetts, adding insurance distribution and potential cross-selling opportunities.
